name: City of Albuquerque/Bernalillo County Area Agency on Aging
organization: City of Albuquerque/Bernalillo County Area Agency on Aging
description: The Area Agency on Aging for this county: information and assistance, home-delivered and congregate meals, in-home services, transportation, caregiver support and senior legal assistance.
next_step: Call and describe what is hard right now. Ask for information and assistance. The Aging and Disability Resource Center, 800-432-2080, also connects you to aging and disability help. Military service is not required.
constraints: Many services focus on people age 60 and older and adults with disabilities; eligibility and waitlists vary by program.
Call the Department of Senior Affairs’ Senior Information and Assistance line, which takes requests for Area Agency on Aging services.

source_evidence.title: New Mexico Governor’s Commission on Disability: Elderly resources
source_evidence.scope: The Non-Metro Area Agency on Aging funds senior programs in every New Mexico county except Bernalillo, which the Albuquerque Area Agency on Aging serves; phones 505-395-2668 and 1-866-699-4927; search excerpt.

name: Non-Metro Area Agency on Aging
description: The Area Agency on Aging for this county: information and assistance, home-delivered and congregate meals, in-home services, transportation, caregiver support and senior legal assistance.
next_step: Call and describe what is hard right now. Ask for information and assistance. The Aging and Disability Resource Center, 800-432-2080, also connects you to aging and disability help. Military service is not required.
constraints: Many services focus on people age 60 and older and adults with disabilities; eligibility and waitlists vary by program.
Tribal elders may also be served by the Indian Area Agency on Aging or the Navajo Area Agency on Aging; the Aging and Disability Resource Center can connect you.

name: New Mexico Long-Term Care Ombudsman Program
organization: New Mexico Long-Term Care Ombudsman Program
description: The regional long-term care ombudsman for this county: advocacy for residents of nursing homes, assisted living and residential care facilities.
next_step: Call the regional ombudsman program. Give the facility name and county. For immediate danger, call 911.
constraints: The ombudsman acts with the resident’s permission and is not a licensing or enforcement agency.
The statewide line connects you with the ombudsman for the facility’s area.
